nodes.machine.deleteConfirm:
Delete the record of machine “{host}”?

The machine row and its command history are deleted permanently (billing and audit are unaffected). This cannot be undone.
nodes.machine.rotateConfirm:
Rotate the agent key of machine “{host}”?

The new key is delivered to the agent over the command channel only; the old key stays valid until the agent confirms (30-minute grace).
nodes.machine.revokeConfirm: Revoke machine “{host}”? Its agent token stops working immediately and its nodes go unreachable.

nodes.form.hostRunnerConfirm:
Create node “{name}” as a host process?

⚠️ It runs with your local user permissions and controls the whole machine (files, terminal, installs).

- dependencies go into the node’s own directory (global npm is untouched)
- creating it leaves an audit record (node_create_host)

Continue?
nodes.form.dangerSandboxConfirm:
Create node “{name}” with the full-access sandbox (ops assistant tier)?

⚠️ This tier grants whole-machine capability (files, terminal, system operations); it is meant for ops assistant nodes on servers you own.

- dangerous operations need an approval card (facade side)
- creation and every unlock leave an audit record
- server credentials stay on the node’s machine; the manager never receives them

Continue?
